findings.text: The company has status 'liquidation' and was wound up on 20 March 2026 under a creditors voluntary liquidation.
Accounts are overdue, with the next filing due on 30 November 2025 and the last accounts made up to 29 February 2024.
There are 2 outstanding charges registered against the company.
PERSON 301 is the current person with significant control, holding 75 to 100 percent of shares and voting rights.
There is 1 current director, PERSON 292, who was appointed on 7 November 2025.
Since 24 October 2025, there was 1 officer appointment and 1 resignation, involving PERSON 292 and PERSON 293 on 7 November 2025.
The registered office address was changed on 1 April 2026.

headline.text: ACME LTD is in liquidation following a creditors voluntary liquidation wound up on 20 March 2026, with overdue accounts and two outstanding charges.
